sentences.text: The available in-force directions say a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans with sanctioned amount/limit up to ₹50 lakh, and they also say no pre-payment charges that were not disclosed as specified may be charged. [E13, E18]

The available findings do not provide any monetary penalty amount for a UCB that levies prohibited foreclosure charges, and the older foreclosure-charge circulars are no longer in force. [R1, R2, E10, E11, E13, E18]

I searched the in-force UCB pre-payment-charge directions for a penalty, fine, or monetary sanction tied to prohibited foreclosure charges, but the cited provisions only state when charges are not permitted. [E10, E11, E13, E16, E18]

missing.slot: monetary penalty amount for levying prohibited foreclosure charges
missing.searched: UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 paragraphs 260-261 and the repeal findings for the earlier foreclosure-charge circulars
